ideas.pitch: A quantitative risk-forecasting dashboard that predicts regional student event safety risks using historical campus incident logs and Poisson regression modeling.
ideas.title: HooSafe AI Incident Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning pattern of hard engineering and probabilistic forecasting demonstrated in the AI-incident-forecasting hackathon win.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered compliance and transaction graph explorer designed to audit student club funding and sponsorship allocations for anomalies.
ideas.title: CavGuard AML and Grant Risk Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs graph intelligence and explainable risk scoring, mirroring the winning blueprint of the Bito AML platform.

ideas.pitch: A no-code strategy builder and automated copy-trading platform tailored for decentralized perpetual exchanges.
ideas.title: CvillePerp DEX Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Captures the grand-prize-winning mechanics of ClashX by offering instant strategy deployment for complex financial markets.

ideas.pitch: An on-campus dining hall nutritional assistant that generates real-time personalized meal plans based on daily macronutrient goals and local menu inventory.
ideas.title: CavBites AI Nutritionist
ideas.why_it_could_win: Repeats the high-impact consumer utility that secured first place at the Mealzy 24-Hour Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent student support platform that connects campus green initiatives with local municipal sustainability data using LangGraph and RAG.
ideas.title: EcoCville Multi-Agent Sustainability Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning multi-agent architecture proven at the GreenNovation Hackathon.
